intent: A precise ⌘K command palette on near-black: grouped results, fuzzy matches marked with a warm accent, full keyboard control and correct combobox ARIA.

stack.fonts: font-sans (Geist) for labels and input, font-mono (Geist Mono) for group labels, hints, keycaps and footer, font-display (Geist, tight tracking) for the background app

layout.section: 720px min-height, #09090b, with a demo app behind: 240px sidebar #0c0c0e (md+), 56px top bar with title and trigger, six issue rows
layout.trigger: 40px field, white/3% with white/10 border and inset highlight, 288px wide from sm, search icon + 'Search or jump to…' + ⌘ K keycaps; icon and keycaps only on phones
layout.scrim: black at 55% with a 2px backdrop blur, click to close
layout.palette: max-w 640px, inset 12/24px, top 76/112px, solid #111113 (no glass), radius 16px, 1px ring white/9%, inset top highlight white/7%, shadow 0 24px 80px -12px black/90%
layout.search: 60px row: 18px icon, borderless input, esc keycap (sm+)
layout.results: max-h min(400px, 100dvh - 240px); groups with mono labels, hairline between groups; rows ≥44px, radius 10px: 28px icon tile, label, hint, shortcut keycaps (sm+)
layout.footer: 44px, white/2%: ↑↓ navigate, ↵ open, esc close; live result count right
layout.keycap: 22px, radius 5px, 1px border white/10, white/4% fill with inset highlight, mono 11px white/60

color.selected: white/6% row with a 3px #ff7a45 left marker; icon tile inverts to white with a black icon
color.accent: #ff7a45 for empty-state underlines and the toast dot; nothing else is coloured

motion.open: y -10px, scale 0.98 → 1, opacity, 220ms, ease [0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1]; exit y -6px
motion.selection: a single highlight and the accent marker glide between rows on a shared layoutId spring (600/44)
motion.choose: chosen row flashes (0.985 scale, brighter highlight) for 130ms before close
motion.press: rows 0.99, trigger 0.98; empty state fades up 6px

responsive.mobile: palette 12px from edges, 76px from top; shortcuts and esc hidden; trigger collapses; footer drops 'esc close'
responsive.sm: palette 112px from top, shortcuts and esc keycap visible, trigger 288px
responsive.md: sidebar appears in the background app

accessibility: input is role=combobox with aria-controls, aria-expanded, aria-autocomplete=list, aria-activedescendant
results role=listbox; groups role=group labelled by headings; rows role=option with aria-selected
↑/↓ wrap, Home/End, Enter runs, Esc clears then closes; focus stays in the input
⌘K/Ctrl+K toggles; focus returns to the trigger on close; trigger has aria-keyshortcuts
result count and empty state are polite live regions

Recent: CSV export drops the last row · OPS-412

avoid: glass panel (the scrim may blur; the palette stays solid)
moving DOM focus into the list
